description: For every fixed PA derivation of an original-language sentence, the chosen certified proof has a root context fresh for every auxiliary name in every PA model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.fixedProof_context_fresh.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {n : ℕ}
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence)
  (hA : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA A)
  (j : M) (x : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.contextFresh.value
      ![j,
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.contextValue
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.rootValue
            ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.fixedProof A hA).value x))] =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1
